title: Establish the Mez Systems Phase 0 control plane
objective: Create a reproducible baseline, governance registers, programme charter, minimum LLM contracts, and an H0 decision packet without changing current production identity rules.

included: Inventory and hash the current Mez Systems pack
Capture live Figma, consumer-repository, and Canvas evidence
Create issue, decision, artifact, and consumer registers
Create task, context, receipt, and evaluation schemas
Prepare a low-burden human approval packet
excluded: Selecting a new visual identity direction

acceptance: The charter defines scope, authority, owners, exceptions, and stop rules
H0 asks only material human decisions
Live mismatches are recorded without being treated as resolved
All four schemas are valid Draft 2020-12 JSON Schema
One Phase 0 task, context, receipt, and evaluation set validates

verification.passCondition: Artifact and screenshot manifests regenerate without error.
The validator returns zero and reports all registers, screenshots, and LLM examples valid.
Desktop, mobile, and narrow evidence exists for the Canvas and defects are recorded.
The executive brand owner approves or amends the seven H0 choices.

humanGate.approvalQuestion: Approve or amend the seven programme-authority decisions in governance/H0-DECISION-PACKET.md.

stopConditions: Do not promote proposed decisions to approved without the H0 response.
Do not modify production identity rules during Phase 0.
Stop if live evidence contradicts the named source or consumer and record the conflict.
Do not assign unconfirmed owners as if they accepted responsibility.
notes: This is the first dogfooded task for the LLM-first execution contract.
